changelog:
• Updated the GeckoView browser engine to 159.0.20261105170000
• Add-ons: install Firefox extensions from Mozilla's list, its add-on site, or a signed file
• Ad blocking now uses the official uBlock Origin, with its own per-site settings from the shield
• The shield shows when your ad blocker is off for a site, turned off, or missing
• Cookie banners are rejected where possible, and hidden otherwise
• App updates download much less, and show their progress while installing
• A page that needs DRM says so, and DRM can be turned on from the shield
• Player: playback speed from 0.25× to 2×, and press and hold to play at 2×
• Links meant for an app ask first, naming the app
• GIF, audio and Safe Folder tasks keep running in the background, with a notification you can cancel
• GIFs are up to 30 seconds long and no longer get stuck near the end
• The app icon returns to the screen you left, and notifications no longer close private tabs
• Downloads from private or background tabs are no longer lost or saved publicly
• Close all tabs closes only the tabs on screen, after asking
• Capture and ad blocking restart by themselves if they stop working
• An occasional request to support Firedown, shown at most three times
• Indonesian and Vietnamese translations, and every other language completed
